import sys

def is_square(s):
    n = len(s)
    if n % 2 != 0:
        return False
    return s[:n//2] == s[n//2:]

input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
t = int(input[0])
results = []
for i in range(1, t + 1):
    s = input[i]
    results.append("YES" if is_square(s) else "NO")
print("\n".join(results))
